name: Memoire ORM
description: Presentation website and documentation for Memoire ORM, the blazing-fast pure-Rust ORM for SQL and NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB). Built with active: pages rendered by a Rust server, WebAssembly islands, installable and offline (PWA).
